original_goal: Generate at least ten distinct title candidates from an approved opportunity, then at least three cover directions from the selected title, with immutable sources and selectable outputs.
requirement_event: Repeated public generation clicks during a slow context read must prepare and submit one exact version; unknown outcomes must replay that same source after reload.
implementation: Shared workbench async request factory owns the lock across context GET, persistence, POST and clearing.
Preparing and Saving status is announced; all sibling mutation controls remain disabled.
Creative history loading or failure prevents uninformed generation; context failures never persist a command.
Selected research batch preparation now uses the same lock instead of handing it off between separate handlers.

evidence.test_boundaries: Actual HotspotsWorkbench, nested CreativeResults/ResearchHistory, useResource and ApiClient; only native fetch, Storage.setItem fault and jsdom missing dialog methods are controlled. No private callbacks or mocked business components.
